'''Trusty Trikker's Guns & Ammo''' was a business operating in the town of [[Bartyn's Landing]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. The enterprise was known for its extreme variety, and was owned by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Trusty Trikker]].
